summary: Bowie County, TX fire tower listed as gone; no build date, staffing, or description of the site today found in the sources read.

facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts marks it Removed and the Forest Fire Lookout Association index marks it Gone; no removal date or site description found

events.note: Listed as the Adams Hill Fire Tower at 33.39, -94.455 in a Texas lookout-tower list marked as revised January 24, 2011

evidence.supports: Index lists the tower as a Tower with status Gone
Forest Lookouts page marks the tower as removed
List names it the Adams Hill Fire Tower in Bowie County at 33.39, -94.455

notes_for_editor: Thin record: three sources, none giving a build date, agency, staffing, fire history or present condition. The tnlandforms numeric column is not explained, so it is not used. The story is under the 120-word floor because the sources say no more; it was not padded. The Forest Lookouts state list shows Adams Hill under Bowie County with no agency. Searches for Adams Hill mostly return the Battle of Adams Hill in Bexar County (1861), a different place, so keep the two apart. Budget used: 2 WebSearch calls and about 6 page reads.
